```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("ExecutiveSummary", inherits = FALSE)) {
  source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "executiveResults.R"))
}
if (!exists("TBL.PGA.TR", inherits = FALSE)) stop("executive results: the caller must define TBL.PGA.TR, the id of the PGA table it places.", call. = FALSE)
if (!exists("PSA_Units", inherits = FALSE)) PSA_Units <- "g"
Units <- .executiveUnits(PSA_Units)
SEP <- " to "
Sa <- function(v) .fmtSa(v, PSA_Units)
Scn <- ExecutiveSummary$scenarios
Mw <- .executiveRange(c(Scn$Mw.minimum, Scn$Mw.maximum), SEP, function(v) .fmt(v, 1))
Sites <- if (nrow(SiteTable) > 1L) paste("the sites", knitr::combine_words(SiteTable$label, and = " and ")) else paste("the site", SiteTable$label)
Envelope <- ExecutiveSummary$envelope
PGA.MCE <- .executiveRange(c(Envelope$minimum, Envelope$maximum), SEP, Sa)
P84 <- if (is.na(Envelope$minimum84)) "" else paste0(" and that of the MCE (84%) is ", .executiveRange(c(Envelope$minimum84, Envelope$maximum84), SEP, Sa), " ", Units)
```

- **Deterministic Seismic Hazard Assessment (DSHA).** The deterministic assessment postulates, for each tectonic source capable of controlling the site demand, its maximum credible earthquake (MCE): the largest reasonably conceivable earthquake under the presently known tectonic framework [@ICOLD2016]. The assessment postulated `r .fmti(nrow(Scn))` scenarios with $M_w$ from `r Mw`; the deterministic design spectrum MCE is their envelope. Table [-@`r TBL.PGA.TR`] reports, for `r Sites`, the PGA of the MCE and of the MCE (84%) by site condition; on reference rock, $V_{S30}=760$ m/s, the PGA of the MCE is `r PGA.MCE` `r Units``r P84`.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("Units", "SEP", "Sa", "Scn", "Mw", "Sites", "Envelope", "PGA.MCE", "P84"), ls()))
```
